            index = hard_consonants.find(first_char)
            new_first_char = hard_consonants[(index - 1) % len(hard_consonants)]
            new_syllables.append(new_first_char + syllable[1:])
        else:
            # Subsequent syllables
            new_syllables.append(syllable[0] + syllable[1:])
    
    # Add "ah", "oh", or "uh" at the end if necessary
    last_char = new_syllables[-1][-1].lower()
